Information about this business (2)

Birch Media is a team of web design, SEO, PPC, and retargeting professionals based in Testville, TN with a passion for helping business owners build their brand to get more website traffic, leads and sales. We work directly with our clients to determine goals, analyze the competition, develop a strategy for success, execute the strategy, and report results.

Posted on March 12, 2015. Brought to you by localcom.

Birch Media is a digital marketing agency that provides web design, SEO, PPC advertising management, social media marketing, and email marketing.

Posted on February 11, 2015. Brought to you by localcom.

Business description (3)

Birch Media is a team of web design, SEO, PPC, and retargeting professionals based in Testville, TN with a passion for helping business owners build their brand to get more website traffic, leads and sales. We work directly with our clients to determine goals, analyze the competition, develop a strategy for success, execute the strategy, and report results.
